response.title: Error 521: Web server is down
response.detail: Cloudflare attempted to connect to the origin web server, but the connection was refused. The origin is down, blocking Cloudflare IPs, or not accepting connections on the configured port.
response.what_you_should_do: **Wait and retry.** Back off for at least 120 seconds. If the error persists, the origin is offline or blocking Cloudflare — the website operator must restart the origin or whitelist Cloudflare IPs.
response.footer: This error was generated by Cloudflare on behalf of the website owner.
